title: Grand Meridian Resort
description: Luxury hotel booking and management platform. Guests register, search rooms with live filters, and reserve through a four-step booking wizard with promo codes and tax-aware pricing, then pay via SSLCommerz or at the front desk. The guest portal tracks a live check-in countdown and stay progress, handles cancellations, receipts and in-room food ordering, and unlocks room-specific WiFi credentials during an active stay.
